lines.line: Uses: Green Kong Switches need at least a Simian Slam, blue ones a Super Simian Slam (5 coins, from Fungi Forest) and red ones, found only in Creepy Castle, a Super Duper Simian Slam (7 coins, from Creepy Castle). Each switch shows one Kong's face, and only that Kong can set it off.

Both the Super Simian Slam and the Super Duper Simian Slam deal the same amount as damage to enemies as the regular Simian Slam.
Blue Switches begin to appear once the player reaches Fungi Forest. However, one appears in Gloomy Galleon's lobby on DK Isles.

lines.line: Summary: Cranky Kong's potions teach the Kongs special attacks and abilities for Banana Bunch Coins, from the free Simian Slam to Hunky Chunky. Cranky's Lab is in all the levels except Hideout Helm.

quoted: Here, the Kongs can purchase, for a certain amount of Banana Bunch Coins, special potions concocted by Cranky to learn special attacks, ranging from Simian Slam to Hunky Chunky.
It appears in all of the levels in DK Isles, except for Hideout Helm.

lines.line: Uses: Each Kong has three abilities that cost 3, 5 and 7 coins in turn. Donkey: Baboon Blast, Strong Kong, Gorilla Grab. Diddy: Chimpy Charge, Rocketbarrel Boost, Simian Spring. Lanky: OrangStand, Baboon Balloon, OrangSprint. Tiny: Mini-Monkey, Pony Tail Twirl, Monkeyport. Chunky: Hunky Chunky, Primate Punch, Gorilla Gone.
